title: Can I send files to people who don't have a CLO license? Will they be able to view or share the files?
content: **Question** Can I send files to people who don't have a CLO license? Will they be able to view or share the files? **Answer** Yes, they can signup and use [CLO-SET](https://clo-set.com/). Signing up for simple functionalities and sharing options is free, and only an email address is needed, no CLO license.
content_description: This webpage provides information on how individuals without a CLO license can access and share files using the free CLO-SET platform.

title: I deleted my account. How can I reactivate my account?
content: **Question** I deleted my account. How can I reactivate my account? **Answer** No, deleted accounts cannot be recovered. When an account is deleted, your CLO account information is permanently removed, along with your previous subscription and payment history. Therefore, please consider carefully before considering deleting your account.
content_description: This web page provides information on the permanent consequences of deleting your account and clarifies that account reactivation is not possible.

title: Does CLO come with a renderer?
content: **Question** Does CLO come with a renderer? **Answer** Yes. CLO provides a renderer to produce photo-realistic 3D Garments.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to inform users that CLO includes a renderer for creating photo-realistic 3D garments.

title: Can I simulate flesh and muscles of Avatars?
content: **Question** Can I simulate flesh and muscles of Avatars? **Answer** No. You cannot simulate flesh and muscles of Avatars in CLO.
content_description: The purpose of this webpage is to clarify that CLO does not support the simulation of flesh and muscles for Avatars.

title: Can I use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars?
content: **Question** Can I use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars? **Answer** To use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars, an advanced configuration so called "Rigging" must be performed and the Rigging structure of the body-scanned Avatars and CLO's default Motion files' Rigging structure must be exactly the same.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on the necessary rigging requirements to use CLO's default Motion files with body-scanned Avatars.

title: Can I use my own accessories (hair, shoes, etc.) for CLO Avatars?
content: **Question** Can I use my own accessories (hair, shoes, etc.) for CLO Avatars? **Answer** You may import personal accessories into CLO as OBJ, FBX and other 3D file types, but they won't be automatically placed where the Avatar's hair or shoes is. To use personal accessories as CLO's hair and shoes, some advanced configuration need to be made in other 3D tools such as Maya. If you would like to use accessories other than default items, please check out [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/).
content_description: Discover how to incorporate your own accessories into CLO Avatars, including the necessary steps for advanced configuration using 3D tools.

title: Is it possible to have an Avatar that has the exact specs as my fit model?
content: **Question** Is it possible to have an Avatar that has the exact specs as my fit model? **Answer** Yes. You may modify and use the default Avatar if the Avatar's size can be approximately the same as your fit model. Also, you may purchase an Avatar similar to your fit model in [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/). However, you need to customize your Avatar through 3D modeling companies if the Avatar's size needs to be exactly the same as your fit model. If you would like to customize your Avatar, please contact the [CLO Global Support Team](https://www.clo3d.com/contact).
content_description: This page provides guidance on creating or purchasing a customizable Avatar that matches your fit model's specifications.

title: Does the Pattern change if I change the size of the Avatar?
content: **Question** Does the Pattern change if I change the size of the Avatar? **Answer** No. Even if you change the size of the Avatar, Patterns maintain their size before the modification.
content_description: This web page clarifies that altering the size of the Avatar does not affect the size of the Patterns.

title: Does CLO offer offline training?
content: **Question** Does CLO offer offline training? **Answer** Yes, CLO also offers offline training for Individual users as well as Enterprise and Academic users. If you are an individual user, check our [Instagram page](https://www.instagram.com/itsclo3d/) where you will find the next offline workshops posted. If you are an Enterprise or Academic user, please contact [our business team.](https://www.clo3d.com/en/support/contactus)
content_description: Discover CLO's offline training options for individual, enterprise, and academic users, including workshop details and contact information for inquiries.

title: How can I create my own trims and hardware?
content: **Question** How can I create my own trims and hardware? **Answer** For most cases, custom trims are made in other 3D tools such as Maya and imported into CLO. If 3D modeling is not feasible, you may request to 3D modeling companies. Advanced CLO users can also create trims using Patterns and export as OBJs.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on creating custom trims and hardware using 3D modeling tools and techniques compatible with CLO software.

title: Do you create ______ (some kind of trims & hardwares) for me?
content: **Question** Do you create ______ (some kind of trims & hardwares) for me? **Answer** Currently, we do not create custom trims, but custom trim service is on the way. If you need trims other than those provided in CLO, please visit [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) and purchase as needed.
content_description: This webpage informs users about the availability of custom trim services in the future and directs them to CLO-SET CONNECT for purchasing existing trims and hardware.

title: What is the purpose of rendering?
content: **Question** What is the purpose of rendering? **Answer** Since real-life lighting and reflection are not applied to the 3D environment in CLO, 3D Garments have less realistic look in the 3D window. Therefore, to create photo-realistic 3D Garments, an additional process called rendering which simulates real-life lighting and reflection on the 3D Garment is needed.
content_description: This web page explains the importance of rendering in creating photo-realistic 3D garments by simulating real-life lighting and reflections.

title: I recorded an animation, but the Garment looks very light as if it is floating. What should I do?
content: **Question** I recorded an animation, but the Garment looks very light as if it is floating. What should I do? **Answer** The 3D Garment may seem floating in animation when the friction between Avatar and Garment and the friction between Garment and Garment are in low values. Please increase the [friction](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002797948). Or, change the [Simulation](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000304968) option from Normal to Complete to express fabric more realistically.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide solutions for improving the realism of 3D garment animations by adjusting friction settings and simulation options.

title: Does CLO come with a rendering solution?
content: **Question** Does CLO come with a rendering solution? **Answer** Yes, CLO includes an internal renderer that will allow you to create realistic high-quality images of your 3D garments.
content_description: Discover how CLO's internal rendering solution enables you to create stunning, high-quality images of your 3D garments effortlessly.

title: Can I animate my garments in CLO?
content: **Question** Can I animate my garments in CLO? **Answer** Yes, after creating garments, you can animate them in [Animation Mode](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000297567) in CLO. Please refer to the [manuals](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000154767-Animation-Mode) to learn how to record animations in CLO.
content_description: Discover how to animate your garments in CLO using Animation Mode with our helpful guides and manuals.

title: Can I suspend my subscription period?
content: **Question** Can I suspend my subscription period? **Answer** No, you cannot suspend your subscription period. The only way to stop your subscription is to [cancel your subscription](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115012642347-Can-I-cancel-my-subscription-). If you are concerned about the infrequent use, we highly recommend you subscribe to a monthly plan instead of a yearly plan.
content_description: This web page provides essential information regarding subscription management, specifically addressing the inability to suspend subscriptions and offering alternatives for infrequent users.

title: I'm using Intel HD Graphic 530 (or 630) and CLO crashes immediately upon launching.
content: **Question** I'm using Intel HD Graphic 530 (or 630) and CLO crashes immediately upon launching. **Answer** Please refer to the manual, [How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001773247-How-to-Fix-the-Error-using-Intel-Graphics-Card), to solve the issue.
content_description: This webpage provides a solution for users experiencing crashes when launching CLO with Intel HD Graphics 530 or 630 by directing them to the relevant troubleshooting manual.

title: Can I import my own trims and hardware?
content: **Question** Can I import my own trims and hardware? **Answer ** Yes. You may import custom trims as OBJs and use the [Glue](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000526728) tool to attach and simulate with 3D Garments. To learn how to load OBJ file as trims in more detail, please refer to the [manual](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107).
content_description: This web page provides guidance on importing custom trims and hardware as OBJs for use with 3D garments, along with links to support tools and detailed instructions.

title: Does CLO provide trims and hardware?
content: **Question** Does CLO provide trims and hardware? **Answer** Yes. CLO provides a variety of trims such as buckles, buttons, buttonholes, rings, zippers, and more, which can be found in the CLO Library. If you need trims other than default ones, you may buy in [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/).
content_description: This web page aims to inform users about CLO's offerings of trims and hardware, including options available in the CLO Library and additional purchases through CLO-SET CONNECT.

title: To what extent can I modify graphics in CLO?
content: **Question** To what extent can I modify graphics in CLO? **Answer** You may perform basic modification on graphics, such as scaling, rotating, changing color, and repeating the graphic along the x-axis and y-axis, and all over the Pattern. To further learn how to edit graphics in CLO, please refer to the [Edit Graphics](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000728248-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%88%98%EC%A0%95) manual.
content_description: Discover the extent of graphic modifications you can make in CLO, including scaling, rotating, and color changes, with a link to the comprehensive editing manual for further guidance.

title: How are fabrics simulated in CLO?
content: **Question** How are fabrics simulated in CLO? **Answer** In CLO, Fabric is expressed as it is made in real life, combining material + prints. Please learn how to [configure Physical Properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716127-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%EB%AC%BC%EC%84%B1) and [create](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003329827-%EC%82%AC%EC%9A%A9%EC%9E%90-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%ED%85%8D%EC%8A%A4%EC%B2%98-%EC%A0%9C%EC%9E%91) and [apply](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000728588-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%ED%85%8D%EC%8A%A4%EC%B2%98) textures.
content_description: Discover how to realistically simulate fabrics in CLO by configuring physical properties and applying textures.

title: How often will I get updates to my subscription?
content: **Question** How often will I get updates to my subscription? **Answer** As a subscribed user, you will receive the program's major updates three times a year, and a few minor patch releases in between each major update with bug fixes. To learn more about each version's new features, please visit [here](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features).
content_description: This webpage provides information on the frequency of updates for your subscription, detailing the schedule for major and minor releases.

title: Can I import my own prints and textures?
content: **Question** Can I import my own prints and textures? **Answer** Yes, for Prints and Textures CLO supports PNG, JPEG, xTex, Normal and Specular Maps, PSD, AI, and TIFF files. Though to retain any transparent elements of a Print, they must be saved as PNG. For Graphics, CLO supports JPEG, PNG, AI and PSD. PNG and AI are the only file types that support transparent elements. **Prints & Textures** **Graphics** **Prints& Textures** To use your own Prints and Textures, please refer to manuals below: * [Fabric: Texture](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000728588-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%ED%85%8D%EC%8A%A4%EC%B2%98) * [Edit Texture](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716407-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%ED%85%8D%EC%8A%A4%EC%B2%98-%EC%88%98%EC%A0%95) * [Fabric: Color](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716427-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%EC%83%89%EC%83%81) * [Create Custom Textures](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003329827-%EC%82%AC%EC%9A%A9%EC%9E%90-%EC%9B%90%EB%8B%A8-%ED%85%8D%EC%8A%A4%EC%B2%98-%EC%A0%9C%EC%9E%91) **Graphics** To use your Graphics, please refer to manuals below: * [Create Graphics](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716147-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%83%9D%EC%84%B1) * [Edit Graphics](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000728248-%EA%B7%B8%EB%9E%98%ED%94%BD-%EC%88%98%EC%A0%95) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Discover how to import and utilize your own prints and textures in CLO, including supported file formats and helpful manuals for customization.

title: If I have a fabric swatch, can it be simulated in CLO?
content: **Question** If I have a fabric swatch, can it be simulated in CLO? **Answer** To accurately simulate your fabric swatch in CLO, you need CLO's Fabric Kit or FDS which needs additional charges. However, Fabric Kit and FDS (Fabric Digitization Service) are ancillary services provided only to companies. The company must be qualified for CLO Business plan (One-person company is not eligible for using the FDS service and Fabric Kit). On the other hand, CLO does provide some emulated fabrics as default assets and you can purchase other varieties of free emulated fabrics in [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/) which can be modified as needed. Please refer to the manual to learn how to edit [fabric properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115000716127-Fabric-Properties-) in CLO. Please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact) if you would like to purchase the Fabric Kit and use the FDS service,
content_description: This web page provides essential information on simulating fabric swatches in CLO, detailing the requirements for using the Fabric Kit and Fabric Digitization Service, as well as available default and purchasable emulated fabrics.

title: How much is the Fabric kit?
content: **Question** How much is the Fabric kit? **Answer** A Fabric kit is an ancillary service provided only to companies that purchased CLO for Business. The company must purchase the Business license before ordering a fabric kit. Please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](http://clo3d.com/contact). For additional fabric inventory, we recommend you explore [CLO-SET CONNECT](https://connect.clo-set.com/).
content_description: This webpage provides information on the availability and purchasing requirements for the Fabric kit offered exclusively to CLO for Business license holders.

title: If I understand correctly, the Stress Map displays the effect the Avatar has on the Pattern, not the effect the Pattern has on the Avatar. Why did you guys choose this method?
content: **Question** If I understand correctly, the Stress Map displays the effect the Avatar has on the Pattern, not the effect the Pattern has on the Avatar. Why did you guys choose this method? **Answer** There are many limitations to the Avatar technologies that are available at the moment (muscle and skin deformation are not taken into account, for example), so any calculations on the effect of Pattern on Avatar would not only be difficult but would be inaccurate.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to clarify why the Stress Map focuses on the Avatar's impact on the Pattern due to current limitations in Avatar technology.

title: Is it compatible with other CAD?
content: **Question** Is it compatible with other CAD? **Answer** Yes. You may import patterns created in other 2D CAD programs as DXF-AAMA or ASTM files and vice-versa.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to inform users about the compatibility of our software with other CAD programs, specifically regarding the import and export of DXF-AAMA and ASTM files.

title: Can I print Patterns from CLO?
content: **Question** Can I print Patterns from CLO? **Answer**
content_description: This web page provides guidance on how to print patterns from CLO software effectively.

title: How long does it take to make virtual fabric using actual fabric?
content: **Question** How long does it take to make virtual fabric using actual fabric? **Answer** It takes about 15 ~20 minutes to create a virtual fabric, performing following three steps: 1. cutting fabric samples, 2. testing fabrics, 3. calculating measurements from the test.
content_description: This web page provides a concise overview of the process and time required to create virtual fabric from actual fabric samples.

title: How accurate are virtual fabrics?
content: **Question** How accurate are virtual fabrics? **Answer** There are two ways to emulate fabric properties in CLO as below. To learn more how each method works, please select the desired option. Use Fabrics in CLO Library Create with Fabric Kit All Fabrics provided in the CLO Library and Fabrics created with the Fabric Kit **have 90% of accuracy**. However, the accuracy may differ when Fabrics' Physical Properties are arbitrarily modified. **Use Fabrics in CLO Library** Navigate to the Fabric folder in the CLO Library to use Fabrics come with CLO. Those Fabrics are emulated with the Fabric kit, measuring Stretch, Bending and other Physical Properties and are about 90% accurate. **Create with Fabric Kit** If you would like to emulate own fabrics by measuring their Stretch, Bending and others, you may purchase CLO Fabric Kit. If you are interested in purchasing CLO Fabric Kit, please contact the [CLO Global Support Team](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: Discover how to achieve 90% accuracy in fabric emulation using CLO's Library and Fabric Kit, and explore the methods for creating your own virtual fabrics.
